verses.text: O Lord, Almightie Alahayam of our Fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and of their righteous seed: who have made heaven and earth, with all the ornament thereof: who have bound the Sea by the word of your Commandment: who have shut up the deepe, and sealed it by your terrible and glorious Name, whome all men fear, and tremble before your power: for the Maiestie of your glory cannot be borne, and your angry threatning towards sinners is importable: but your mercifull promise is vnmeasurable and vnsearchable: for you are the most High Lord, of great compassion, long suffering, very mercifull, and repent of the evils of men. You, O Lord, according to your great goodness have promised repentance, and forgiuenesse to them that have sinned against you: and of your infinite mercies have appointed repentance to sinners that they may be saued. You therefore, O Lord, that art the Alahayam of the just, have not appointed repentance to the just, as to Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, which have not sinned against you: but you have appointed repentance to me that am a sinner: for I have sinned above the number of the sands of the Sea. My transgressions, O Lord, are multiplied: my transgressions are multiplied, and I am not worthy to behold and see the height of heaven, for the multitude of mine iniquitie. I am bowed downe with many yron bands, that I cannot lift up mine head, neither have any release: For I have prouoked your wrath, and done evil before you, I did not your will, neither kept I your Commandments: I have set up abominations, and have multiplied offences. Now therefore I bow the knee of mine heart, beseeching you of grace: I have sinned, O Lord, I have sinned and I acknowledge mine iniquities: therefore I humbly beseech you, forgiue me, O Lord, forgiue me, and destroy me not with mine iniquities. Be not angry with me for ever, by reseruing evil for me, neither condemne me into the lower parts of the earth. For you are the Alahayam, even the Alahayam of them that repent: and in me you will show all your goodness: for you will saue me that am vnworthy, according to your great mercy. Therefore I will praise you for ever all the days of my life: for all the powers of the heavens do praise you, and yours is the glory for ever and ever, Amen.
